company.name: TechNexion Ltd_彤晟科技股份有限公司

description.text:
Join our ARM team to lead and shape Board Support Package (BSP) development for next-generation NXP i.MX and NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
【BSP Architecture & Infrastructure】
Design, enhance, and maintain Yocto Project meta-layers and automated CI/CD build environments.
Collaborate with core architects to execute full BSP releases, establishing a deep understanding of upstream/downstream migration.
(Senior candidates will have the opportunity to lead sub-projects and mentor junior members).
【Smart & Efficient Culture】
Leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., Copilot, LLMs) to bypass tedious code refactoring and focus on complex architectural problems.
We measure impact and engineering excellence, not the count of standard working hours.
